prompt: In at most three sentences, explain to a non-technical manager why a web service can become slow after a sudden spike in visitors.
judge_criteria: Use at most three sentences.
Avoid unexplained technical jargon.
Name at least one plausible cause, such as limited capacity or requests queueing for shared resources.
Do not claim certainty about a specific cause.
reference_answer: When many people arrive at once, the service may not have enough capacity to handle every request immediately. Requests then wait in line for shared resources, which makes pages slower for everyone.
